sentences.text: Tatum Beatrice O'Neal -LRB- born November 5 , 1963 -RRB- is an American actress and author .

She is the youngest person ever to win a competitive Academy Award , which she won in 1974 at age 10 for her performance as Addie Loggins in Paper Moon opposite her father , Ryan O'Neal .	Ryan O'Neal	Ryan O'Neal	Academy Award	Academy Award	Paper Moon	Paper Moon (film)

She also starred in The Bad News Bears , in 1976 , followed by Nickelodeon -LRB- 1976 -RRB- , and Little Darlings -LRB- 1980 -RRB- .	The Bad News Bears	The Bad News Bears	Nickelodeon	Nickelodeon (film)	Little Darlings	Little Darlings
She is also known for being Michael Jackson 's first girlfriend .	Michael Jackson	Michael Jackson
In 1986 , O'Neal married professional tennis player John McEnroe , with whom she had three children .	John McEnroe	John McEnroe
The couple separated in 1992 and were divorced in 1994 .
